title: Animal Mech Lab - Knight branch
user_brief: Explore knight-like armor inspired by the supplied illustration, much slimmer AC6-inspired hands shared across all mechs, and richer metallic materials while keeping low-poly geometry.
hand_policy: Use H01 as the shared hand reference for every new concept in this round and future lab concepts. Historical round 1 remains a comparison record.

references.role: Armor style and elegant knight silhouette; original user-supplied reference, not an exact-copy target.
Slim hand proportions and construction; small crop, no hidden details inferred as facts.
Generated common hand architecture for the four new mech concepts.

concepts.name: Ivory Paladin
concepts.silhouette: Tall twin crest, flared pauldrons, narrow waist and long tapered tassets.
concepts.purpose: Translate the reference's elegant knight silhouette into a few large armor shapes.
concepts.palette: Ivory painted metal, satin steel, restrained warm brass and burgundy.
concepts.design: A — IVORY PALADIN. A tall elegant knight mech with a small closed visor helmet and two slim straight crest prongs, broad flared triangular pauldrons, a sharply tapered breastplate and narrow black articulated waist. Two long flat tapered hip tassets frame slim powerful legs with pointed knee guards and elongated faceted greaves. Two simple burgundy cape panels hang BEHIND the torso and legs, kept apart from hands and feet, made from only a few broad flat planes with no intricate cloth folds. Ivory slightly reflective painted armor, exposed satin steel at joints and bevel planes, a few broad warm-brass trim blocks, burgundy cape interior. Do not copy the reference's crosses, numbers, line decoration or exact head. Keep machinery visible at waist and elbows. Slim shared H01 hands in their unchanging silver and gunmetal.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original full-body low-poly knight mech concept for Version 2 of Animal Mech Lab.

Input roles:
Image 1 is the user's knight mech illustration, used for knightly armor language, elegant proportions, visor helmet, broad pauldrons, chest plate, fauld/tassets and pointed greaves. Invent a NEW mech; do not reproduce the exact illustration, symbols, writing, weapon, shield or ornaments.
Image 2 is H01, the SHARED MECHANICAL HAND MASTER. Every mech in this series uses this SAME mirrored pair of thin silver-over-gunmetal hands, the same palm shape, same finger link design, same wrist collar, same proportions, same materials. Match these hands closely and scale them as a practical small mech component; armor design may vary but HAND DESIGN MUST NOT VARY.

Primary request: an original knight-like industrial combat mech in the spirit of Armored Core, expressed as a deliberately simple PlayStation-era low-poly 3D game model. Strong unique silhouette from a few broad armor forms. A mechanical pilotable chassis, compact sensor visor, armored torso, narrow articulated waist, two arms and two legs. Knight influence is built into functional armor shapes, not a human wearing a metal costume.

Shared H01 hands, CRITICAL: both hands visible, empty, slim and delicate compared with the forearm armor. Same compact gunmetal palm, shallow angular satin-silver back plate, short narrow polygonal wrist collar, long thin angular finger struts, silver dorsal strips, dark joint gaps. EXACTLY FIVE INDIVIDUAL DIGITS on EACH hand: FOUR separate fingers (index, middle, ring, little) in a row plus ONE distinct opposable side thumb. Four long fingertips plus one side thumb, ten total across both hands. Three simple links per finger. No bulky fingers, mitts, pincers, oversized palm blocks, claws, three-finger grippers or differently colored hands. Fingers are narrow, about one fifth of the palm width, gently spread so all four long fingers and thumb are readable. Whole hand including palm and fingers is roughly the length of the helmet, and much narrower than the gauntlet. Hands should feel like the user's AC6 reference rather than the oversized block hands of an old toy robot.

Geometry and materials: VERY low-poly main geometry, a small number of broad flat polygon faces on each armor plate, flat-sided wedges and prisms, visibly faceted four/six-sided hinge joints, angular silhouettes, minimal bevels. Enrich MATERIALS without increasing geometric detail: satin/brushed steel, slightly reflective painted metal, restrained brass/silver trims where specified, broad specular reflections that reveal flat faces, very subtle low-resolution surface grain or light edge wear. Keep large clean areas. No dense panel lines, etched scrollwork, tiny decals, miniature fittings, exposed wires, complex pistons, round high-poly surfaces, photorealistic greebles, triangulated texture overlay, voxel construction or glossy plastic. Metallic faces can reflect light while the geometry stays crude and faceted.

Presentation: ONE complete mech, front three-quarter view at about 20 degrees, standing upright with a little grounded weight, neutral lighting, arms slightly away from torso and both empty hands fully visible against the backdrop, backs of hands/palms angled enough to count all five separate digits. All head crests, armor, hands and feet inside frame with comfortable margins. Plain near-white studio background, soft floor contact shadow only. Portrait around 3:4, high clarity at hand scale. No weapons, shields, held objects or large equipment hiding hands. No labels, diagram, insets, text, religious emblems, logos or watermark.

concepts.name: Iron Bulwark
concepts.silhouette: Low visor helmet, high gorget, broad squared shoulders and a wide armored stance.
concepts.purpose: Test a heavy knight whose identity comes from shoulder and collar masses.
concepts.palette: Brushed iron, charcoal and a few muted blue painted faces.
concepts.design: B — IRON BULWARK. A heavy broad knight mech with a small flat-topped slit-visor helmet tucked into a high angular gorget, huge thick trapezoid pauldrons sloping outward and a wide deep pentagonal breastplate. A short waist above two short broad hip tassets, thick upper legs, blocky knee guards and wide planted sabaton-shaped feet. Compact adult-proportioned tank-like armored mass, without chibi scaling. Shoulders and greaves are plain big faceted pieces, no horns, cape or spikes. Brushed mid-gray iron armor faces, charcoal recesses and joint blocks, a few muted desaturated blue painted panels. Highlights run across broad metal facets. Large forearm armor still ends in the SAME small slim H01 silver-over-gunmetal hands, fully visible.

concepts.name: Silver Lancer
concepts.silhouette: Single swept helmet crest, slim chest, high shoulder fins and long angular greaves.
concepts.purpose: Test a fast knight frame with a sparse silhouette and long mechanical limbs.
concepts.palette: Satin silver, dark steel and restrained desaturated teal.
concepts.design: C — SILVER LANCER. A very lean tall knight mech with a compact pointed visor helmet and ONE swept-back flat crest, a narrow lance-tip-shaped breastplate, two compact sharply rising shoulder wedges, slim upper arms and tapered angular forearms. Long thin exposed dark waist, high pelvis, short split fauld plates and long athletic mechanical legs with high angular knee points and narrow planted sabaton feet. No actual lance or other weapon; the lancer idea is expressed by the upward rhythm and tapered silhouette. No cape. Sparse satin-silver main armor, dark steel underframe and a few large desaturated teal inserts, restrained silver specular bands across flat planes. All armor shells use very few faces. Use the same compact slim H01 hands, identical silver-over-gunmetal construction.

concepts.name: Black Errant
concepts.silhouette: Wedge visor, one broad swept pauldron, compact opposite shoulder and angular skirt armor.
concepts.purpose: Test an asymmetric knight through large plate shapes and a balanced mechanical stance.
concepts.palette: Graphite metal, satin steel and restrained wine-red panels.
concepts.design: D — BLACK ERRANT. A medium-height knight mech with a low forward wedge visor helmet, a tight peaked breastplate, and bold armor asymmetry: one very broad swept polygonal pauldron versus one compact close-fitting shoulder cap. A narrow visible mechanical waist, diagonally flared flat hip tassets, sturdy long shins with a single broad ridge per greave and angular planted sabaton feet. Two flat layered back plates suggest a short armored mantle ending above the knees; no flowing cloth. Graphite-black metal main plates, visible satin-steel edge planes and underframe, a few large dark wine-red shoulder/hip panels. Do not add ornaments to the black armor; the large swept silhouette carries the design. Both forearms have practical armor cuffs, while the SAME unchanging H01 slim silver-over-gunmetal hands are fully visible and countable.
